steps.title: Welcome to Omarchy
steps.screen: Let's make sure you're online and up to date. Then, if you like, a hands-on tour of the keys.
steps.done_when: The user starts the tutorial or closes the welcome screen.

steps.title: Meet the Super key
steps.screen: Super is the key with the Windows logo, or ⌘ on a Mac keyboard, between Ctrl and Alt. Almost every Omarchy shortcut starts with it. Press it once.
steps.done_when: The app sees the key press while focused.

steps.title: Open the Omarchy menu
steps.screen: Almost everything lives in here. When you're lost, start here.

steps.title: Launch and tile two apps
steps.screen: Omarchy places windows side by side for you. Open two and watch them tile behind this card.
steps.done_when: A terminal and a browser are open on the same workspace and focus has moved once.

subtasks.label: Move focus to the other window

steps.title: Close, float and full screen
steps.screen: Any window can float above the others, fill the screen, or close.

subtasks.label: Float a window, then tile it again

steps.title: Workspaces
steps.screen: Each number is a workspace: a separate desktop. Super + a number jumps there.
steps.done_when: A workspace switch and a move-to-workspace are seen.

subtasks.label: Jump to workspace 2, then back with Super + 1

steps.title: Copy and paste the Omarchy way
steps.screen: Super + C, V and X copy, paste and cut everywhere, even in the terminal. Select the line in the terminal that opened, copy it, then paste it below.
steps.done_when: The field contains the expected text.

subtasks.label: Select the line in the terminal and copy it
Click the field below and paste

steps.title: Find any shortcut
steps.screen: You don't need to memorize anything. Super + K is always there. Close it with Esc.

subtasks.label: Open the list of every shortcut

steps.title: Pick a theme
steps.screen: Arrow keys move, Enter applies. Everything restyles at once, this card included.
steps.done_when: A theme is applied (keeping the current one counts).

steps.title: Display and comfort
steps.screen: Check that text is a comfortable size, and try the night light.
steps.done_when: The user confirms it looks right.

subtasks.label: Scale up, then down again (Super + Alt + /)
Try the night light (press again to turn it off)

steps.title: Your everyday apps
steps.screen: Your everyday apps each have their own shortcut. Try one.

steps.title: You're ready
steps.screen: That's the tour. Super + K shows every shortcut, and Super + Space opens the menu. Run omarchy onboarding to see this again, or omarchy onboarding --step <name> for one lesson.
